shippingPolicy:
Shipping and delivery

Delivery charges are shown at checkout after you enter your address and select your packs. Review the final total before placing your order. Product prices include applicable tax.

Our current store delivery rates are ₹50 per started 500 g for local Hisar delivery, ₹100 per started 3 kg within Haryana, and ₹150 per started kg for interstate delivery. The delivery address, PIN code and pack weights determine the applicable zone and charge. The amount displayed at checkout applies to your order.

Delivery is arranged by our team. A delivery quote does not confirm a courier booking or a delivery date. Contact us if you need to confirm delivery availability or timing before ordering. Where tracking information is available, you can find it in your account.

Please provide a complete address, six-digit PIN code and reachable phone number. For an address correction or delivery issue, contact nutriheavenhsr@gmail.com or call 90172-25722 with your order number.
returnPolicy:
Returns and refunds

You may request a return within 7 days after the recorded delivery of your order. Sign in to your account, open the order and provide a reason for the request. For a guest order or help with a damaged, incorrect or missing item, contact nutriheavenhsr@gmail.com or call 90172-25722 with your order number and details of the problem. Photographs can help our team review the issue.

A return request is subject to review. Please wait for our team's approval and return instructions before sending any items. Keep the product and its packaging available while the request is reviewed. Our team will explain the next steps and any return arrangements for your specific order.

Refunds are processed through our order support workflow after approval. For an online payment, an approved refund is submitted through the payment provider; the provider and your bank determine when the credit appears. Any refund for cash on delivery requires a separate arrangement with support. Contact us with your order number to check a request or refund status.

For cancellation requests, use the option in your account where available or contact support promptly. Cancellation availability depends on the order's current fulfilment and payment status.
privacyPolicy:
Privacy policy

Nutri Heaven uses the information you provide to operate this store, manage your account, process orders and respond to support requests. This includes your name, email address, phone number, delivery address, shopping bag, order records and information you send to support. Account passwords are stored as password hashes.

Online payment processing is handled by Razorpay. Our system stores payment references and payment status so we can confirm orders and manage refunds. Payment details entered in Razorpay's checkout are handled by the payment provider. Delivery information is shared with the people or services arranging delivery of your order.

We use service providers for database hosting, transactional email and store media. Where enabled, Meta Pixel sends browsing and commerce events to Meta to measure advertising activity. Newsletter subscriptions use an email confirmation process, and you may unsubscribe using the link in newsletter emails.

The store uses browser storage to keep your shopping bag, sign-in session and recoverable payment attempt. Checkout contact and address drafts are saved in the current tab for up to 24 hours, cleared after checkout completes, and are unavailable after the tab session ends. Clearing browser storage signs you out and may remove recovery information.

Technical request logs help us operate and troubleshoot the service. Account, order and payment records are retained for store operations and record keeping; this policy does not promise a fixed deletion date. To request access, correction or deletion of your information, contact nutriheavenhsr@gmail.com. We will review the request and explain any records that must be retained.

Contact: nutriheavenhsr@gmail.com or 90172-25722.
terms:
Terms and conditions

These terms describe how shopping with Nutri Heaven works. Please review the product, pack size, quantity, contact details, delivery address, shipping charge and final total before submitting your order. Prices are displayed in Indian rupees and product prices include applicable tax.

Orders are subject to available stock and successful processing. An online payment must be confirmed before the order can proceed through fulfilment. Cash on delivery is payable when the order is delivered. If a payment is pending or interrupted, resume the saved checkout or check payment status before attempting another payment. Contact support if you have paid but the order is not confirmed.

Shipping arrangements and charges are described in our Shipping policy. Delivery timing should be confirmed with support when it is important to your purchase. Return, cancellation and refund requests follow our Returns and refunds policy and the current status of your order.

Please use accurate information and keep your account credentials secure. Contact us promptly about an unauthorised account action, incorrect order or payment discrepancy. Read product labels and ingredient information before use, particularly if you have allergies or dietary requirements; contact support if you need more product information before ordering.

Our Privacy policy explains how information is used to operate the store. By placing an order, you agree to these terms and acknowledge the Privacy policy presented at checkout.

For order or product assistance, contact nutriheavenhsr@gmail.com or call 90172-25722 and include your order number where applicable.
